book.name: LUCAS
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ LUCAS

content: Sk'aneal Yet Jix Bet Ec' Jesús Sattaj Naj Pilato
Jix a linan masanil eb tu', catu' jix i'letoj Jesús yu eb sattaj naj Pilato.

Catu' jix c'oli sna'on a k'ane eb yiban. Jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —Jix kil on, ja' jun winaj ti', lalan yak'on somcha el sc'ul eb ket conob on. Jix yala tol c'am chi ske' kak'on ch'en tumin chi k'anle el yu naj yaaw a Roma. Catu' chi yalon pax oc sba Cristoal, chi yal yel oc apnoj, rey, ẍi eb.
Jix sk'anlen naj Pilato tu' tet jaxca ti': —Chin k'anle e ach, ¿Tumi sreyal jaach eb Israel tu'? ẍi naj tet Jesús. —Jaa', yel toni, quey ton tu' jaxca ja walon tu', ẍi naj tet naj Pilato.
Jix yalon Pilato tu' tet eb yaaw yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios yetoj eb ánima ey ec' titu' jaxca ti': —Ja' jun winaj ti', c'am nioj smul chi wabe, ẍi tet eb.

Pero tol jix yi' atej sc'ul eb yalon junel xa jaxca ti': —Pero ja' jun winaj ti', masanil eb a Judea ti' lalan somcha el sc'ul eb yu stit sjowal yin gobierno yu wan cuybanile chi yak'a. Ja' tax bey Galilea jix el yich yalon wan cuybanile chi yal ti', masanta' c'al jix jul titi', ẍi eb tet Pilato.
Sk'aneal Yet Jix Bet Ec' Jesús Sattaj Herodes
Ja' yet jix yaben Pilato wan tu', jix sk'anlen tet eb, ta tol a Galilea Jesús tu'.
Ja' yet jix yabeni, tol a Galilea toni, yuxan jix yatoj tet Herodes, yutol ja' naj Herodes yaaw ye bey Galilea tu'. Ja' yet tu' ey ec' Herodes tu' ca-oxeb c'ual bey Jerusalén tu'.
Ja' yet jix yilon sjul Jesús sattaj, caw jix tzalai, yutol ey xa stiempoal yaben sk'umal Jesús tu'. Yuxan caw chi yoche chi k'anab nioj yetoj. Catu' chi yochen chi yil junoj milagro chi yune'.
Ec'al tzet jix sk'anle el tet Jesús tu', pero c'am c'al tzet jix spajtze.
Ja' eb yaaw yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios, jix apni eb yetoj eb cuywam yin sley Moisés. Yel c'ulal tol jix sna' a k'ane eb yiban naj.

Yuxan jix bawa a Herodes yetoj eb soldado yin Jesús tu'. Catu' jix buchwa eb yin naj sic'lebil. Jix tz'aj yaon oc jun pichile eb caw watx' yin naj, jaxca yet eb rey. Jix lawi jun tu' xin, catu' jix ale paxtoj bey Pilato tu' junel xa.
Ja' to yet jun c'ual tu', jix yamigone a sba naj Pilato tu' yetoj naj Herodes tu'. Yutol ja' yet yalantoj, scajat sba eb.
Yet Jix Na'le Oc Yin Jesús
Jix yal Pilato tol chi syamba oc sba eb yaaw yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios yetoj eb yaaw, c'al masanil ánima.

Catu' jix yalon xol eb jaxca ti': —Ja' jun winaj jix je yi'tej e in ti' an, che yala tol chi somcha el eb ánima yu. Pero ilala je sattaj jix jin k'anle tet, c'am nioj smul chi txeclo el jaxca je yalon yin tu'.
Ja'c'ala' Herodes, c'am nioj mule jix ilcha el yin naj yu. Yuxan, jix ẍej pax tej cu c'atan junel xa. Yuxan c'am nioj smul smoo scam yu.
Yuxan tu' c'al oj wak' mak'le an, catu' oj jin jajon el oj, ẍi tet eb.
Ja' sley Pilato tu', tol chi sjaj el jun jun a presowom yet jun jun k'in pascua.
Ja' yet jix yaben ánima tol quey tu' oj yun naj, jix a yaw eb yin ipal jaxca ti': —Ja' jun winaj ti', cam ojabi. Ja' ojab naj Barrabás cha jaj el oj, ẍi eb.
Ja' naj Barrabás tu', ey oc preso yutol locan xol eb jix yak'le jowal yetoj eb yaaw yul conob tu', catu' mak'om pax cam ánima naj.
Ja' naj Pilato tu', caw chi yoche chi sjaj el Jesús. Yuxan, quey tu' jix yute yalon tet eb ánima tu' junel xa.
Pero ja' yet jix yaben eb jaxca tu', caw jix a yaw eb yalon jaxca ti': —Tol chi cam yin culus. Tol chi cam yin culus, ẍi eb.

Jix yalon naj Pilato tet eb yin yoxelal jaxca ti': —¿Tzet yu xin? ¿Tzet jix sey smulne che yila? Jainti', c'am nioj smul tol smoo scam yu chi wil an. Yuxan, tu' c'al oj wak' mak'le an, catu' oj jin jajon el an, ẍi tet eb.

Pero tol caw jix yi' atej sc'ul eb. Jix a yaw eb sic'lebil, tzet utbil tol sowalil chi cam naj yin culus. Caw ip jix a yaw eb yetoj eb yaaw yak'omal xaambal eb tet Dios. Yuxan jix yak' c'al ta' ganar eb.
Yuxan jix yal Pilato tu' jaxca ti': “Ske' ojab jaxca chi yoche eb tu'” ẍi naj.

Yuxan, ja' jun winaj locan xol jowal tu', jun mak'om cam ánima ey oc preso tu', ja' jix jajle el oj jaxca jix yute sk'anon eb tu'. Jal Jesús jix ale can toj yul sk'ab eb yu chi yun tzet yetal chi yoche eb chi yun yin tu'.
Sk'aneal Yet Jix Oc Jesús Yin Culus

Ja' yet lalan yi'ontoj Jesús eb bey oj cam tu', ey jun winaj a Cirene chi yij Simón, lalan sjul naj, jix bet ec'ab naj naat, jix smitx'on a eb. Jix yak'on te' culus eb tu' yij naj. Catu' jix oc tzajan yintaj Jesús.
Ec'al pax ánima jix oc tzajan yintaj. Ec'al eb ix, chi el yaw yok' yin naj.
Jix meltzotoj jacan Jesús yin eb, catu' jix yalon jaxca ti': —Jex txo ix a Jerusalén, manchej jex ok' win an. Ok'an nej je yin. Ok'an nej yin eb je yune'.

Yutol ey jun tiempoal oj jul oj catu' oj je yalon jaxca ti': “Caw watx' yet eb ix c'am yune', c'al eb man unewom ix oj, yetoj eb ix c'am yune' chi yak' txutxwoj, watx' pax yet eb,” je chi oj je yaloni.

Ja' yet jun tiempoal tu', oj yal eb ánima yu wonanlaj jaxca ti': “Tol oj wal ey tzet utbil chi yun stit wejna wan wonan tu' kiban,” ẍi eb oj yalon eb. Oj yalon pax eb yu tzalanlaj: “Ey oj wal tzet utbil chi yun cu muji can yalan wan tzalan tu',” ẍi eb oj yalon eb.

Jainti', jaxca tol yax te' jin an, ta chi yun eb jaxca ti' e in an, yutol c'am jin mul, yel xa c'al yel miman tzet oj yun eb je yin, yutol laan jex jaxca junoj te' te' caw tajin xa, yutol ey je mul yul sat eb, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Ey cawan xa mac txequel ey smul jix i'letoj cam yetoj Jesús.

Jix apni eb bey jun lugar chi yij Calavera. Chi yal yel oc apnoj Calavera, “Sbajil Jolome.” Ja' tu' jix slocba a Jesús eb yin culus. Catu' jix slocban pax a cawan ey smul tu' eb. Jun bey swatx' k'ab Jesús, jun bey sq'uexan.

Ja' yet lalan slocbale a Jesús yu eb, catu' jix yalon jaxca ti': —Mamin ak' miman c'ulal yin eb, yutol man yotaj oj eb tzet chi yune', ẍi Jesús tet Dios. Jix c'oli yak'on suerte eb soldado yin spichil Jesús tu', catu' jix spo'on ec' an eb yin.

Ja' eb ánima, jix oc bulan eb yilon wan tzet yetal chi yun tu'. Jix c'oli sbuchwa eb yaaw yin Jesús tu'. Jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —Jix colcha wan ánima yu. Jal tinani', ta tol yel ja' Cristo ti', catu' ja' sic'bil el yu Dios, scol ojab sba kila, ẍi eb.
Ja'c'ala' eb soldado pax oj, caw chi buchwa atoj eb yin. Jix apni eb scawilal. Jix yak'on eb vinagre yuq'ue.
Jix yalon eb tet jaxca ti': —Ta tol yel sreyal jaach eb Israel, col ja ba kila, ẍi eb tet.
Ey jayeb k'ane ey oc sjolomtaj naj. [Tz'ibebil oc yin sti' eb Griego, eb Romano, yetoj eb Israel] ẍi jayeb k'ane tu' jaxca ti': “Ja' jun mac txequel ti', sreyal eb Israel,” ẍi.
Ey jun eb naj locan a yetoj tu', jix buchwa yin, jix yalon jaxca ti': —Ta tol yel jaach Cristo jaach, col ja ba wil an. Chi lawi jun tu' chon ja colon pax ja wetoj, ẍi naj tet Jesús.
Jal jun xa naj yetbi tu', jix tenchaneni, jix yalon naj jaxca ti': —¿Tumi c'am chach xiw nioj tet Dios? Ilala, lalan kaben sya'il yetoj.
Jaonti', cu moo kaben sya'il, yu cu tolanen el cu penail. Pero jun ti', c'am nioj tzet jix el yuneni, ẍi naj.
Catu' jix yalon naj tet Jesús jaxca ti': —Jesús, tol oj wal chin ja na'tej yet oj jaach jul ja wak'on Yaawilal, ẍi naj tet Jesús.
Jix yalon Jesús tu' tet jaxca ti': —Caw yel chi wal e ach, yet jun c'u ti', oj jaach apnoj wetoj an bey jun lugar chi yij Watx'ilal, ẍi Jesús tet naj.
Scamichal Jesús
Ja' yet chuman xa c'u jix k'ejbi masanil yul yiban k'inal ti', masanta' c'al yet a las tres.
Jix k'ejol el c'u. Catu' jix tzilchatoj snan an k'ap ey oc smajil oj yul snan stemplo Dios.
Catu' jix a yaw Jesús yin ipal jaxca ti': —Mamin, chi wak' can jin pixan yul ja k'ab, ẍi Jesús tet Dios. Yet jix lawi yalon jaxca tu', jix cami.
Ja' yet jix yilon naj scapitán eb soldado tzet jix yune', jix yal naj watx' k'ane tet Dios. Jix yalon naj jaxca ti': —Caw yel, ja' jun winaj ti', caw c'am spenail, ẍi naj.
Ja' masanil ánima chi matz'li, jix yil masanil eb tzet jix yune'. Ja' yet jix paxtoj eb, caw chi cus sc'ul eb sic'lebil.
Ja' masanil eb jix otajnen Jesús c'al wan eb ix ix jix oc tzajan yintaj yet jix tit bey Galilea, naat jix can linan eb, catu' chi matz'litej eb.
Jix Mujle Octoj Smimanil Jesús Yul Jun Ch'en
Ey jun winaj chi yij José, a conob Arimatea yul yet Judea. Watx' sc'ul naj, catu' watx' pax sbeybal naj. Yaaw ye xol eb yet yaawil.
Ma yaoc sba yetoj eb yet jix yunen eb jaxca tu'. Yutol lalan yechbanen swa'xi oc Dios yak'on Yaawilal.
Jix octoj José tu' bey Pilato, jix bet sk'anon eytej smimanil Jesús.
Catu' jix bet yi'on eytej tu'. Catu' jix spichon oc yul jun sábana. Catu' jix bet yaon can octoj yul jun ch'en ch'en jolbil xa. C'am to junoj camom chi mujle yul jun jolan tu'.
Ja' yet jun c'ual tu' lalan xa c'al yey c'u, catu' sc'ual pax yak'on lista sba eb Israel yu tzet chi sk'an yu eb yet jun xa sc'ual xewilal tuxa oj jul oj.
Ja' eb ix jix oc tzajan yintaj naj bey Galilea tu', jix bet eb yil ch'en ch'en tu'. Jix bet yilon eb tzet utbil jix yun yale can octoj smimanil naj yul ch'en.
Catu' jix paxtoj eb. Jix bet swa'nen wan ambal suk'uk'i sab eb, yetoj wan sak'al yel sab chi jo'le oc yin smimanil tu'. Ja' yet sc'ual xewilal tu', jix xew eb jaxca ta' yalon sley eb.
